Duplicated editability gate rejected native NSTextView with omitted AXEnabled and writable selected text. Reuse the existing verified AX text-target reader.

Whole-window pixels reject clicks when the insertion point blinks. Identified native pointer targets use stable signed application/window authority plus exact target/label-region pixels; unknown or cross-window targets remain strict.
Fixture lacked an Edit menu, so literal Command+A did not select all. Correct the fixture with the standard responder-chain command.

Native completion rejected an unchanged signed editable field because caret paint changed. AXBoundsForRange was vertically offset; a bounded insertion-point pixel comparison uses unchanged text/focus/window and only a narrow vertical change inside the rounded field footprint plus one image pixel of paint halo.
Approval red exposed reoffering a performed token and revival of a rejected token. Performed approvals require their continuation; failed dispatch retires the token.
boundaries: Literal Option vs Control vs Command and key ambiguity rejection
Used and rejected approval tokens cannot replay or revive
Uncertain input cannot replay on Resume or process restart
Cancellation rejects late proposals and concurrent execution
Cancellation immediately after dispatch retains the action in history on Resume
A task ID cannot inherit a different byte-exact goal
Insertion-point-only pixel changes tolerate fractional AX/image rounding; changed text, other controls, horizontal changes and pixels outside the field halo fail
limitations: Native executor is not selected by the production loader. Fara remains browser-only in production.
Scripted proposals prove app execution, not trained-model interpretation or general task accuracy.
Native provider tool profiles and actual-model form/document/cross-app comparison remain open.
Move, drag, native scroll and clarification/status continuation remain unsupported; capability profiles must not advertise them before implemented.
Real login/provider flow, host/phone Take Control/Resume/Stop composition and native focus-takeover matrix remain open.
A temporary pixel diagnostic passed with a 300 ms delay; it is diagnostic only. Final workflow has no added diagnostic delay.
Current-code shared regression bundle includes one existing priority-inversion warning; no thermal or whole-app 12 GB acceptance.
